description: Distribution grid frequency measurements at five sites is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Maitreyee Dey. Data Specifics:The provided data encompasses real-time series of micro-synchrophasor frequency information gathered through a device at solar sites situated in England, United Kingdom. Within each site's directory, there exists data for the duration of April 2023. Within the monthly folder, there are daily files holding timestamps and grid frequencies for entire days. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The repository holds 5 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1881831135 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
